name: mergekit
summary: The essential open-source toolkit powering SLERP, DARE-TIES & Frankenmerge combinations across almost every top Hugging Face roleplay model.
ranking_rationale: Enables merging storytelling, prose, and instruction models on CPU/low-VRAM without full retraining (trade-off: CLI YAML tool aimed at model creators rather than end chatters).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Enables merging storytelling, prose, and instruction models on CPU/low-VRAM without full retraining
Powers virtually the entire Hugging Face creative/RP model-merging scene
cons: CLI YAML tool aimed at model creators rather than end chatters
Bad merge weights can degrade long-context coherence
